input._script:
using JSON3, CUDA
res = Dict{String,Any}("device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())), "julia" => string(VERSION), "cuda" => string(CUDA.runtime_version()))
oneline(e, n) = replace(first(sprint(showerror, e), n), "\n" => " ¦ ")
M = Module(:MP)
Core.eval(M, :(using JACC, CUDA))
res["jacc_version"] = try string(pkgversion(M.JACC)) catch e; "?" end
res["backend"] = try string(M.JACC.default_backend()) catch e; "?" end
# the lines of the JACC CUDA extension that name a stream, a sync, or the reduce
try
    root = joinpath(dirname(dirname(pathof(M.JACC))), "ext")
    ls = String[]
    for (d, _, fs) in walkdir(root), f in fs
        endswith(f, ".jl") || continue
        p = joinpath(d, f)
        for (k, l) in enumerate(eachline(p))
            occursin(r"sync|stream|launch_spec|LaunchSpec|parallel_reduce|reduce!", l) && length(ls) < 90 && push!(ls, relpath(p, root) * ":" * string(k) * ": " * strip(l)[1:min(end, 160)])
        end
    end
    res["ext_lines"] = ls
catch e
    res["ext_lines"] = oneline(e, 300)
end
Base.include_string(M, """
function slow!(i, x, n)
    s = 0.0
    for k in 1:n
        s += sin(k * 1.0e-3 + i)
    end
    @inbounds x[i] = (s == 12345.678) ? 0.0 : 1.0
    return nothing
end
function slowread!(i, x, out, n)
    s = 0.0
    for k in 1:n
        s += sin(k * 1.0e-3 + i)
    end
    @inbounds out[i] = x[i] + (s == 12345.678 ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    return nothing
end
function plus1!(i, x, y)
    @inbounds y[i] = x[i] + 1.0
    return nothing
end
launch_slow(x, N, n) = JACC.@parallel_for range = N sync = false slow!(x, n)
launch_slowread(x, out, N, n) = JACC.@parallel_for range = N sync = false slowread!(x, out, n)
launch_plus1(x, y, N) = JACC.@parallel_for range = N sync = false plus1!(x, y)
red_sum(x, N) = JACC.@parallel_reduce range = N (((i, x) -> x[i]))(x)
""")
N = 1 << 16
dev(v) = M.JACC.array(v)
launch_sync(x, N, n) = nothing
Base.include_string(M, """
launch_slow_sync(x, N, n) = JACC.@parallel_for range = N slow!(x, n)
""")
res["reduce"] = Dict{String,Any}()
let x = dev(zeros(N))
    n = 20000
    M.launch_slow_sync(x, N, n)
    r = M.red_sum(x, N); res["reduce"]["after_sync_launch"] = string(typeof(r), " ", r isa AbstractArray ? Array(r) : r)
    for nn in (20000, 200000)
        x = dev(zeros(N)); M.launch_slow(x, N, nn)
        r = M.red_sum(x, N); res["reduce"]["after_async_n$(nn)_nosync"] = string(typeof(r), " ", r isa AbstractArray ? Array(r) : r)
        CUDA.synchronize()
        x = dev(zeros(N)); M.launch_slow(x, N, nn); CUDA.synchronize()
        r = M.red_sum(x, N); res["reduce"]["after_async_n$(nn)_sync"] = string(typeof(r), " ", r isa AbstractArray ? Array(r) : r)
    end
    # a reduce of values written by kernel, read twice
    x = dev(zeros(N)); M.launch_slow(x, N, 200000)
    r1 = M.red_sum(x, N); r2 = M.red_sum(x, N)
    res["reduce"]["twice_after_async"] = string(r1 isa AbstractArray ? Array(r1) : r1, " ", r2 isa AbstractArray ? Array(r2) : r2)
    res["reduce"]["N"] = N
end
println(JSON3.write(res))
